title: NaijaAI Program Review 2026: Is It Safe to Sign Up?
description: NaijaAI Program review: what its site claims about a $250 deposit, AI trading and a 4.6/5 rating, and what to check before you sign up.
author: Michael Brooks
excerpt: NaijaAI Program promotes AI trading with a $250 minimum and a 4.6/5 rating, but names no operator or regulator.
content:
NaijaAI Program is presented as an AI-assisted trading platform with automated trades, a demo account and a $250 starting point. The page gives no operator, no regulator and no licence number, while its only performance measure is an unsourced 4.6/5 rating.

The name suggests a training programme, but the page describes an automated trading tool. Its table lists debit cards only, and the body lists crypto. What the page states is set out here, together with the points we could not establish.

Is NaijaAI Program Legit? What the Claims Show

Automation and signals

The page says AI and machine learning generate signals and can place trades automatically, with a manual mode for users who prefer control. The strategy, model and risk limits are not described, which leaves the claim untestable from the page alone.

Performance and ratings

The page refers to a high success rate and notable gains from a small deposit, but gives no return figures, time period, sample size or method. No source or review count is given for the 4.6/5 rating.

Asset coverage

The name suggests a training programme, but the page describes an automated trading tool. Its table lists debit cards only, and the body lists crypto. The page does not reveal which markets are genuinely available until after registration.

Costs and Minimum Deposit

The page states a $250 minimum deposit and says there are no registration, transaction or withdrawal fees. No fee schedule is shown, and spreads and payment-provider charges go unmentioned.

Our reference minimum here is 250 in local currency, meaning AUD 250 for Australian readers, GBP 250 in Britain and EUR 250 across the EU. A $250 amount appears with no currency named, so confirm the sum and its currency in the terms before you pay.

Who Is Behind NaijaAI Program

The page names no legal entity, company number or address. Every sign-up link leads to coinpulse.cc, which is a third-party domain, with no statement on whether the publisher is paid for the referral.

Is NaijaAI Program a Scam? Withdrawals and Complaints

Searches for NaijaAI Program often ask whether it is a scam, whether withdrawals work and whether there are complaints. The page states withdrawals are usually completed within a day, but gives no limits, timelines or complaint route.

Look for complaint records and reviews from independent sources, with the sources named, before you deposit. A rating or a set of positive testimonials does not reveal how withdrawals are processed.

Before You Register: A Short Checklist

  • Find the legal company behind NaijaAI Program and check it against your national regulator's register.
  • Get the fees, spreads and withdrawal charges set out in writing.
  • Look for performance records that carry dates and can be checked, instead of a single rating.
  • Begin with the smallest sum you could bear to lose, and test the demo first.

Risks to Keep in Mind

The main risk is an unnamed operator, because a user has no clear party to hold to account. Contradictions among the claims make that risk larger. Having a system place trades does not stop the account from losing money.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is NaijaAI Program legit?

The site makes claims about NaijaAI Program but names no operator, regulator or licence number. Before paying in, check both the company registry and the regulator's register.

What is the minimum deposit for NaijaAI Program?

No currency is named alongside the $250 figure. Read the terms to confirm both the sum and its currency before you pay.

Is NaijaAI Program regulated?

No regulator or licence is given, and the brokers referred to are left unidentified. Check your national regulator's register for the business that runs the service.

Does NaijaAI Program charge fees?

The page says there are no fees but lists no schedule for spreads, withdrawals or currency conversion. Read the full terms first.

Does automation make losses impossible?

No. Having a system place trades does not stop the account from losing money.

Our Verdict on NaijaAI Program

NaijaAI Program's page makes broad claims without naming an operator, a regulator or verifiable results. Our rating reflects these gaps. This review will be updated when the operator and its claims can be verified. Commit nothing you are not prepared to lose.
